title: Complex Agents, Shallow Tests: Demystifying and Enhancing Test Adequacy of Agent Harness in the Wild
title_zh: 复杂智能体与浅层测试：揭示并提升真实环境中智能体框架的测试充分性

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agentic systems are emerging as a new software paradigm. Modern agents are typically composed of backbone LLMs and a surrounding harness that serves as the operational software infrastructure for agent execution. As agent harnesses grow increasingly complex, agents suffer from diverse harness implementation bugs, raising substantial reliability concerns. In this work, we conduct the first empirical study to systematically investigate the test adequacy of harness in real-world agentic systems. Our analysis reveals that agent harness remains substantially undertested. In particular, LLM-dependent harness (LDH) code, despite its critical role in processing LLM outputs and governing agent behavior, receives limited testing attention, with less than half of its lines and branches covered by existing tests. Motivated by these findings, we further propose HarnessTester , the first harness-oriented test generation technique that incorporates explicit agent-harness contract support to construct contract-faithful test setups and extensively exercise LDH code. Our evaluation shows that HarnessTester substantially outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose test generation techniques in achieving 75.95%/84.76% larger line/branch coverage gains and 69.89% larger mutation-score gains. Furthermore, HarnessTester detects 122 real-world harness bugs in widely-used agentic systems (e.g., OpenClaw), among which, 88 bugs are previously-unknown bugs and 69 bugs have been confirmed by agent developers. These results highlight the practical effectiveness of HarnessTester in improving test adequacy and assuring the reliability of real-world agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统正在成为一种新的软件范式。 现代智能体通常由核心 LLM 和外围的“控制框架”组成，该框架充当执行智能体所需的软件基础设施。 随着智能体控制框架日益复杂，智能体面临着各种框架实现中的错误，这引发了严重的可靠性问题。 本研究首次通过实证方法，系统性地探讨了真实世界智能体系统中控制框架的测试充分性。 我们的分析表明，智能体的控制框架仍存在严重的测试不足问题。 特别是，依赖 LLM 的控制框架（LDH）代码虽然在处理 LLM 输出和调控智能体行为方面起着关键作用，却很少受到测试关注：现有测试对其代码行和分支的覆盖比例均不足一半。 基于这些发现，我们进一步提出了 HarnessTester——首个面向控制框架的测试生成技术。该技术通过显式支持智能体与控制框架之间的契约关系，构建符合契约的测试场景，并对 LDH 代码进行全面测试。 我们的评估表明，HarnessTester 在测试覆盖率和变异测试得分方面显著优于当前最先进的通用测试生成技术：其代码行和分支覆盖率分别提升了 75.95% 和 84.76%，变异测试得分则提升了 69.89%。 此外，HarnessTester 在广泛使用的智能体系统（如 OpenClaw）中检测到了 122 个真实世界的控制框架错误，其中 88 个是此前未知的错误，另有 69 个已得到智能体开发者的确认。 这些结果凸显了 HarnessTester 在提升测试充分性和保障真实世界智能体系统可靠性方面的实际有效性。

paragraphs.en: Driven by recent advances in large language models (LLMs), LLM-based agentic systems (also called agents) are emerging as a new software paradigm and have been increasingly adopted across a wide range of domains ( Anthropic, ; Devin, 2026 ; Cursor AI, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Kannan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) . paragraphs.en: An agentic system is typically viewed as the composition of probabilistic backbone LLMs and a surrounding harness ( Li et al., 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ; Rajasekaran, 2026 ; Young, 2025 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ) . While LLMs provide reasoning capabilities, harnesses serve as the operational software infrastructure that wraps around the LLM to provide critical functionality spanning execution environment management, context and memory management, guardrail and governance, workflow orchestration, and tool interface. Harnesses in modern agentic systems often comprise a large codebase, e.g., the harness of OpenClaw contains over 196,000 lines of code ( OpenClaw, 2026 ) . Recent studies have shown that substantial improvements in agent performance can be achieved through optimizing harnesses alone while the backbone LLMs remain unchanged ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Consequently, there has been increasing effort in harness engineering ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ; Rajasekaran, 2026 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ) , which focuses on building a more capable harness layer to unleash the capabilities of backbone LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统通常被视为由概率性核心大型语言模型（LLM）和外围的“控制层”（harness）共同组成（Li et al., 2026；Ning et al., 2026；Rajasekaran, 2026；Young, 2025；Lopopolo, 2026）。 虽然大型语言模型提供了推理能力，但控制层则充当了操作性的软件基础设施，包裹在大型语言模型周围，提供包括执行环境管理、上下文与记忆管理、安全护栏与治理、工作流协调以及工具接口在内的关键功能。 现代智能体系统中的控制层通常包含庞大的代码库，例如 OpenClaw 的控制层就包含了超过 196,000 行代码（OpenClaw, 2026）。 近期研究表明，即使核心大型语言模型保持不变，仅通过优化控制层也能显著提升智能体的性能（Zhang et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026）。 因此，控制层工程领域获得了越来越多的关注（Zhang et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026；Rajasekaran, 2026；Lopopolo, 2026），其核心目标是构建能力更强的控制层，以充分发挥核心大型语言模型的能力。

paragraphs.en: Despite the tremendous potential, agentic systems suffer from pervasive reliability issues ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Microsoft AI Red Team, 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) , leading to severe real-world consequences ( Yagoubi et al., 2026 ; Down, 2026b ; Down, 2026a ; AI Incident Database, 2025 ; Halamish and Tokarev, 2026 ) . Particularly, as modern agentic systems have grown increasingly complex, recent studies reveal that agent applications and frameworks suffer from diverse harness implementation bugs ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Rahardja et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2025 ) . These reliability concerns highlight an urgent need for systematic techniques to assure the agent reliability ( Pan et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管智能体系统具有巨大的潜力，但它们普遍存在可靠性问题（Cemri 等人，2025；Microsoft AI Red Team，2026；Sun 等人，2026；Deng 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2025；Bai 等人，2026；Xiao 等人，2026），并导致严重的现实世界后果（Yagoubi 等人，2026；Down，2026b；Down，2026a；AI 事件数据库，2025；Halamish 和 Tokarev，2026）。 尤其值得注意的是，随着现代智能体系统日益复杂，近期研究揭示，智能体应用和框架存在多种实现错误（Chen 等人，2026；Rahardja 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2026a；Zhu 等人，2026；Xue 等人，2025）。 这些可靠性问题凸显了迫切需求系统性的技术来确保智能体的可靠性（Pan 等人，2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Testing, which examines whether a software system exhibits expected runtime behaviors under given inputs, has long been a cornerstone of software reliability assurance. In particular, test adequacy criteria, such as code coverage ( Zhu et al., 1997 ) and mutation scores ( Jia and Harman, 2011 ) , provide important indicators of test quality by measuring how thoroughly a test suite exercises the program under test and its ability to detect bugs. To date, test adequacy has been extensively studied and widely adopted in traditional software development ( Weyuker, 1986 ; Zhu et al., 1997 ; Jia and Harman, 2011 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 测试旨在检验软件系统在给定输入下是否表现出预期的运行时行为，长期以来一直是确保软件可靠性的基石。 特别是，测试充分性标准（例如代码覆盖率（Zhu 等，1997）和变异分数（Jia 和 Harman，2011））通过衡量测试套件对受测程序的覆盖程度及其检测错误的能力，为评估测试质量提供了重要指标。 迄今为止，测试充分性已在传统软件开发中得到广泛研究和应用（Weyuker，1986；Zhu 等，1997；Jia 和 Harman，2011）。

paragraphs.en: Despite the growing adoption of agentic systems and their substantial reliability concerns, how adequately their harness implementations are tested by agent developers during development and maintenance remains largely unexplored. Although numerous benchmarks ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) have been proposed to evaluate agentic systems, they primarily measure task-level end-to-end success by treating agents as black boxes, without examining how thoroughly their internal harness implementations are exercised. This leaves a fundamental question about the testing practices of real-world agentic systems: How thoroughly do agent developers test the agent harness implementations during development and maintenance, and how effective are these tests at detecting harness bugs?
paragraphs.zh: 尽管智能体系统的采用日益广泛，但其可靠性问题也备受关注，然而，在开发和维护过程中，智能体开发者对其底层实现进行了多充分的测试，这一问题在很大程度上仍未得到探索。 虽然已有大量基准测试（Jimenez et al., 2024；Sun et al., 2026；Merrill et al., 2026）被提出用于评估智能体系统，但这些测试主要将智能体视为黑箱，通过衡量任务层面的端到端成功来评估性能，并未考察其内部底层实现是否得到了充分调用。 这引出了一个关于现实世界中智能体系统测试实践的根本问题：在开发和维护过程中，智能体开发者对其底层实现进行了多彻底的测试？这些测试在检测底层实现中的错误方面又有多有效？

paragraphs.en: Empirical Study. To fill this knowledge gap, we conduct the first empirical study to systematically analyze the test adequacy of agent harness in the wild. Our key insight is that LLM-dependent harness (LDH) , the harness code with explicit data or control dependencies on LLM outputs, deserves particular testing attention, as it is responsible for correctly processing nondeterministic LLM outputs spanning a vast value space. Recent work ( Chen et al., 2026 ) also shows that many agent failures occur during interactions between LLMs and harness. Therefore, beyond conventional test adequacy analysis over the entire agent codebase, we specifically investigate the test adequacy of LLM dependent harness code. To this end, we study the test adequacy of 10 large-scale and widely-used agentic systems (e.g., OpenClaw ( OpenClaw Contributors, 2026 ) ) from diverse domains (e.g., coding, general-purpose applications, and scientific discovery), through the following research questions.

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Overall Test Adequacy. Our quantitative analysis shows that real-world agent harness remains substantially undertested. Particularly, LLM-dependent harness code, despite its critical role in processing LLM outputs and governing agent behavior, receives limited testing attention: less than half of LDH lines and branches are covered, with an average mutation score of only 33.60%. Such a gap leaves reliability risks from LLM-harness interactions largely unexposed by current testing practice in agent systems. Moreover, we find that achieving high LDH test adequacy is challenging, as it requires contract-faithful test setups that satisfy the expected data structures, runtime states, and interaction protocols across harness components.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1：整体测试充分性。 我们的定量分析表明，真实世界中的智能体框架仍存在严重的测试不足。 特别是，依赖大语言模型的框架代码虽然在大语言模型输出处理与智能体行为控制中发挥关键作用，却获得的测试关注有限：LDH 的代码行和分支覆盖率不足一半，平均突变得分仅为 33.60%。 这种差距导致智能体系统中大语言模型与框架交互所引发的可靠性风险，在现有测试实践中基本未被暴露。 此外，我们发现实现高 LDH 测试充分性颇具挑战，因为这需要构建符合契约规范的测试环境，以覆盖框架各组件间预期的数据结构、运行时状态和交互协议。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Semantic Test Adequacy. Beyond the aggregate coverage reported in RQ1, we characterize the semantics of LDH predicates and examine test coverage across semantic categories. Our manual analysis reveals diverse semantic patterns in what LDH predicates control, how they make decisions, and what forms of LLM-derived values they process. Predicates with explicit schemas, bounded value spaces, or directly controllable decisions (e.g., tool action and policy guards) are generally better covered, while larger gaps arise for those involving dynamic execution contexts or open-ended value spaces (e.g., agent orchestration). These results highlight the challenge of adequately testing LDH as the required test input spaces become implicit, dynamic, and difficult to enumerate.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：语义测试充分性。 除了 RQ1 中报告的总体覆盖率之外，我们还描述了 LDH 谓词的语义特征，并检验了跨语义类别的测试覆盖率。 我们的手动分析揭示了 LDH 谓词所控制的内容、其决策方式以及其处理的 LLM 派生值形式等方面的多样化语义模式。 具有显式模式、有限值空间或直接可控决策（例如工具动作和策略守卫）的谓词通常覆盖得更好，而涉及动态执行上下文或开放值空间的谓词（例如智能体编排）则存在更大的覆盖缺口。 这些结果凸显了充分测试 LDH 的挑战性，因为所需的测试输入空间正变得隐式、动态且难以枚举。

paragraphs.en: Harness-Oriented Test Generation Technique. Given the prevalent test inadequacy of agent harnesses revealed in our study, we further propose HarnessTester , an LLM-driven test generation technique specifically designed to extensively exercise LLM-dependent harness code in agentic systems. Inspired by our finding that reaching target harness requires test setups that satisfy interaction requirements across harness components, HarnessTester enables harness-oriented test generation with explicit support for agent harness contracts , which specify the expected data structures, execution preconditions, interaction protocols across harness components.
paragraphs.zh: 面向智能体框架的测试生成技术。 鉴于我们的研究揭示了智能体框架普遍存在的测试不足问题，我们进一步提出了 HarnessTester——一种由大语言模型驱动、专门用于全面执行智能体系统中依赖大语言模型的框架代码的测试生成技术。 受我们发现“实现目标框架需要满足各框架组件间交互要求的测试设置”这一结论的启发，HarnessTester 支持面向智能体框架的测试生成，并明确支持智能体框架契约，该契约规定了预期的数据结构、执行前提条件以及各框架组件间的交互协议。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Test Adequacy Improvement. Our evaluation results show that the tests generated by HarnessTester achieve substantially higher coverage and mutation scores than all the four state-of-the-art LLM-based test generation techniques ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Qodo AI, 2025 ; neu-se, 2024 ) . HarnessTester outperforms the strongest baseline selected for each agent and metric by achieving 75.95%/84.76% larger mean LDH line/branch coverage gains and a 69.89% larger mean mutation-score gain. Our ablation study further demonstrates the substantial contribution of agent-harness contract support in HarnessTester .
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：测试充分性改进。 我们的评估结果表明，HarnessTester 生成的测试在覆盖率和变异分数方面显著高于所有四种当前最先进的基于 LLM 的测试生成技术（Altmayer Pizzorno 和 Berger，2025；Zhou 等，2026；Qodo AI，2025；neu-se，2024）。 HarnessTester 在平均 LDH 行/分支覆盖率提升方面分别达到 75.95%/84.76%，变异分数平均提升 69.89%，从而优于为每个智能体和指标选择的最佳基线模型。 我们的消融研究进一步证明了智能体-测试框架契约支持在 HarnessTester 中的重要作用。

paragraphs.en: RQ4: Real-World Harness Bug Detection. We further evaluate the test adequacy of tests generated by HarnessTester through their capability to detect real-world harness bugs. In RQ4.a, among 250 historical harness bugs, tests generated by HarnessTester detect substantially more bugs than the best baseline (43 versus 2). In RQ4.b, we further apply HarnessTester to the latest versions of the studied agents to discover previously unknown bugs. HarnessTester identifies 122 harness bugs, among them, 88 are previously unknown bugs and 69 have been confirmed by developers by the paper submission time. These results demonstrate the practical effectiveness of HarnessTester in uncovering real-world harness bugs and improving the reliability of agentic systems.

paragraphs.en: Agentic Systems and Agent Harness. Modern agentic systems (e.g., OpenClaw ( OpenClaw, 2026 ) ) are becoming increasingly complex and are typically viewed as the composition of probabilistic backbone LLMs and a surrounding harness ( Li et al., 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ; Rajasekaran, 2026 ; Young, 2025 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ) . The harness surrounding the backbone LLMs serves as the operational software infrastructure that provides critical functionality, including execution environment management, context and memory management, guardrails and governance, workflow orchestration, and tool interfaces. Meanwhile, growing research efforts have focused on harness engineering ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ; Rajasekaran, 2026 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ) , aiming to develop systematic methodologies for optimizing the agent harness layer. In particular, proper harness design and implementation have been shown to substantially improve the capabilities of agentic systems even when the backbone LLMs remain unchanged ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Lou et al., 2026 ) . These advances highlight the importance of harness quality, aligning well with our motivation to examine the test adequacy of agent harnesses.

paragraphs.en: Testing for Agentic Systems. paragraphs.en: LLM-based Test Generation. A growing body of work has explored LLM-based test generation ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Schäfer et al., 2024 ; Lemieux et al., 2023 ; Ryan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , demonstrating strong effectiveness in generating diverse and semantically meaningful tests. However, existing techniques are primarily designed for general software systems. As revealed by our study, generating high-adequacy tests for LDH requires contract-faithful test setups that satisfy interaction requirements across harness components. To address this challenge, we propose the first harness-oriented test generation technique HarnessTester that enhances LLM-based test generation with agent harness contract support. Our experiments further confirm the substantial improvements in test coverage and bug detection capabilities from HarnessTester compared to existing general-purpose LLM-based test generators ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Qodo AI, 2025 ; neu-se, 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: Extraction. Existing program analysis frameworks provide general machinery for interprocedural data-flow and control-flow analysis ( Reps et al., 1995 ; Avgustinov et al., 2016 ) , but they do not directly capture the LLM-specific semantics required by LDH extraction. Particularly in agent harness, LLM outputs can originate from heterogeneous model providers and invocation abstractions, and subsequently flow through agent-specific representations, such as message objects, structured responses, and tool-call structures. Consequently, extracting LDH requires explicitly identifying LLM-output sources and modeling how output-derived values propagate through these abstractions. Therefore, to automate LDH extraction, we implement an interprocedural harness analysis tool that models LLM invocations as sources and propagates the corresponding data- and control dependency facts throughout the program until a fixed point is reached. We include all the explicit dependency through assignments, field or container accesses, parameter and return flows, and other taint-preserving transformations. Implementation details are in our artifact ( HarnessTester, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: In this study, we focus on the following test adequacy metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们关注以下测试充分性指标。

paragraphs.en: Coverage. We include the widely used coverage metrics, i.e., line and branch coverage ( Zhu et al., 1997 ) , which calculate the ratio of lines and branches exercised by tests. In particular, we collect both (i) project-wide coverage, which focuses on the coverage over the entire codebase of the studied agent repository; (ii) LDH-wide coverage, which focuses on the coverage over LLM-dependent harness code. We collect coverage with the widely-used coverage package ( Coverage.py Contributors, ) for Python, and the coverage providers integrated with Vitest ( Vitest Contributors, ) for TypeScript.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖率。 我们采用了广泛使用的覆盖率指标，即行覆盖率和分支覆盖率（Zhu 等人，1997），用于计算测试所执行的代码行和分支的比例。 具体而言，我们收集了以下两类覆盖率：(i) 项目级覆盖率，重点关注所研究智能体仓库整个代码库的覆盖情况；(ii) LDH 级覆盖率，重点关注对 LLM 依赖的测试辅助代码的覆盖情况。 对于 Python，我们使用广泛使用的 Coverage.py（Coverage.py 贡献者）包来收集覆盖率；对于 TypeScript，则使用与 Vitest（Vitest 贡献者）集成的覆盖率提供工具进行收集。

paragraphs.en: Mutation Score. While coverage measures how extensively code is exercised, mutation testing assesses the fault detection capabilities of tests by injecting artificial faults into the program under test. A mutant is considered as killed by a test when the test passes on the original program but fails on the mutated program; and the mutation scores calculate the ratio of killed mutants to all the generated mutants. Therefore, to measure how sufficiently existing tests can detect the potential bugs in LLM-harness interaction, we further present the mutation scores over LDH. In particular, we apply the common mutation tools mutmut ( Hovmöller and others, ) and StrykerJS ( Stryker Mutator, ) to generate mutants on LLM-dependent harness code, and present the proportion of killed mutants.
paragraphs.zh: 变异分数。 虽然覆盖率衡量代码被执行的广泛程度，但变异测试通过向被测程序注入人工故障来评估测试的故障检测能力。 当一个测试在原始程序上通过但在变异程序上失败时，该变异体就被认为被该测试杀死；而变异分数则计算被杀死的变异体与所有生成的变异体之比。 因此，为了衡量现有测试在多大程度上能够检测出 LLM-harness 交互中的潜在错误，我们进一步给出了 LDH 上的变异分数。 具体来说，我们使用常见的变异工具 mutmut（Hovmöller 等，）和 StrykerJS（Stryker Mutator，）来生成依赖 LLM 的 harness 代码的变异体，并展示了被杀死的变异体的比例。

paragraphs.en: LDH Prevalence. As shown in Column “LDH share”, LDH represents a relatively compact portion (i.e., less than 45% of executable lines) of the agent codebase, while containing a comparatively high concentration of decisions. In particular, across all studied agents, the LDH branch share is 1.10-1.75 times its line share. One possible explanation is that LLM outputs are frequently consumed by decision-making logic, such as parsing and validating model responses, dispatching actions, and updating agent states. Meanwhile, it is also as expected that agent codebase contains substantial supporting code that does not directly depend on LLM outputs, e.g., provider initialization, model configuration, and execution environments management, which typically do not consume model-produced values. Overall, the LDH distribution confirms the necessity of further complementing project-wide test adequacy with an additional focus on LLM-dependent harness code.

paragraphs.en: Limited Test Coverage. As shown in Column “LDH Coverage” and “Project Coverage”, most studied agents exhibit limited test coverage at both the project and LDH levels. Across the entire codebase, more than half of the executable lines and branches remain uncovered by existing tests on average. In addition, despite the importance of LDH, it does not consistently receive higher test coverage than the project as a whole. Specifically, LDH line coverage is lower than project-level line coverage in eight of the ten agents; for branch coverage, LDH achieves comparable or higher coverage in six agents but lower coverage in the remaining four. In summary, these results show that existing agentic systems mostly remain undertested regarding the test coverage, with a limited testing attention drawn to the critical LLM-dependent harness code.

paragraphs.en: Limited Fault Detection Effectiveness. As shown in Column “Mutation Score”, existing tests also show limited effectiveness in detecting injected mutants in LLM-dependent harness code. Mutation scores range from 3.58% for RD-Agent to 70.94% for Kimi Code, with an average of only 33.60%. It indicates that, on average, about two-thirds of the injected faults in LDH cannot be detected by any existing tests. These undetected mutants arise for two main reasons: some are not even exercised by any test (e.g., 38.36%) , while others (e.g., 25.92%) are exercised but survive because the tests fail to propagate or capture the behavioral changes introduced by the mutations. Overall, the results further reveal the limited capabilities of existing agent tests in detecting bugs occurring in LLM-dependent harness code, implying that existing testing practices cannot fully mitigate the reliability risks arising from LLM–harness interactions during agent execution.

sents.en: Overall, the results further reveal the limited capabilities of existing agent tests in detecting bugs occurring in LLM-dependent harness code, implying that existing testing practices cannot fully mitigate the reliability risks arising from LLM–harness interactions during agent execution.

paragraphs.en: Although all studied agents, including Kimi Code, extensively use mocks to isolate LLMs and other external components, which is a consistent observation as prior work ( Pan et al., 2026b ) , simply using mocks does not necessarily make deeper harness behavior easy to reach. Model outputs often flow through multiple harness components before reaching deeper LDH logic, where each component may expect specific input structures, runtime states, and interaction sequences. Our inspection shows that Kimi Code provides systematic test support for satisfying these requirements. For example, reusable helpers construct mocked model responses with the required fields for different scenarios, such as turn completion and tool invocation. Fake LLMs and scripted generators reproduce valid interaction sequences, while local HTTP/SSE servers and environment fakes reproduce the runtime interactions required for provider communication and tool execution. Together, these utilities help tests construct valid execution contexts and vary model outputs, interactions, and runtime states to exercise different harness behaviors. These requirements resemble the classic notion of software contracts ( Meyer, 1992 ; Beugnard et al., 1999 ) , which specify the obligations and guarantees governing interactions between software components. In the context of agentic systems, these requirements form agent-harness contracts , capturing how model-proposed actions map to tool interfaces, how returned observations correspond to the originating calls, and how subsequent decisions depend on state established through preceding interactions. Reusable test utilities in Kimi Code effectively encode many of these contracts, making it easier to construct both contract-faithful and diverse execution contexts to exercise different decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管所有受研究的智能体（包括 Kimi Code）都广泛使用模拟对象来隔离大型语言模型和其他外部组件——这一发现与先前的研究（Pan et al., 2026b）一致——但仅仅使用模拟对象并不一定能让更深层的 harness 行为更容易被触发。 模型输出通常会流经多个 harness 组件，之后才会到达更深层的 LDH 逻辑；而每个组件都可能期望特定的输入结构、运行时状态和交互序列。 我们的检查表明，Kimi Code 为满足这些需求提供了系统化的测试支持。 例如，可重用的辅助工具能够根据不同的场景（如轮次完成和工具调用）构建包含所需字段的模拟模型响应。 虚假的大型语言模型和脚本化生成器可以重现有效的交互序列，而本地 HTTP/SSE 服务器和环境模拟组件则能重现提供商通信和工具执行所需的运行时交互。 这些工具共同帮助测试构建有效的执行上下文，并通过改变模型输出、交互和运行时状态来触发不同的 harness 行为。 这些需求类似于经典的软件契约概念（Meyer, 1992; Beugnard et al., 1999），该概念定义了软件组件之间交互所遵循的义务与保证。 在智能体系统的语境中，这些需求构成了“智能体-harness 契约”，它描述了模型提议的动作如何映射到工具接口、返回的观察结果如何对应于初始调用，以及后续决策如何依赖于先前交互所建立的状态。 Kimi Code 中的可重用测试工具有效地编码了其中许多契约，从而更容易构建既符合契约又具备多样性的执行上下文，以触发不同的决策。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, OpenClaw, which exhibits much lower test adequacy, provides a representative counterexample. Although its tests also contain extensive mocks and fixtures, they are organized in a relatively ad hoc manner, making it difficult to construct contract-faithful setups across diverse test scenarios. At the model-output boundary, parsers, dispatchers, and error handlers often contain branch-rich logic over response structures and content. While a single mocked response may exercise a nominal path, exploring different decisions requires diverse responses that still satisfy the expected provider-response contracts. Reaching deeper LDH logic can be even more challenging, as model-derived values may flow through multiple components, such as agent runners and gateways. Reaching a target path therefore requires tests to configure their callbacks, exchanged data, runtime states, and environments consistently. Without reusable support for constructing such setups, developers must repeatedly identify and assemble the required test context and its variants for different execution paths. Compared with Kimi Code, OpenClaw may therefore face greater difficulty in constructing test setups that are both contract-faithful and sufficiently diverse.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，OpenClaw 的测试充分性明显较低，因此提供了一个典型的反例。 尽管其测试也包含大量模拟和固定设置，但这些元素的组织方式相对随意，导致在不同测试场景中难以构建符合契约要求的测试环境。 在模型输出边界处，解析器、调度器和错误处理程序通常针对响应结构和内容包含复杂的分支逻辑。 虽然单个模拟响应可能覆盖一条典型路径，但要探索不同的决策，则需要多样化的响应，同时这些响应仍需满足预期的提供者-响应契约。 要触及更深层的 LDH 逻辑可能更具挑战性，因为模型生成的值可能会流经多个组件，例如智能体运行器和网关。 因此，要触达目标路径，测试必须能够以一致的方式配置回调函数、交换数据、运行时状态和环境。 如果没有可重用的支持来构建此类测试环境，开发者就必须为不同的执行路径反复识别并组合所需的测试上下文及其变体。 与 Kimi Code 相比，OpenClaw 在构建既符合契约要求又足够多样化的测试环境时，可能会面临更大的困难。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these cases suggest that adequate LDH testing depends on test-side setups that are both sufficiently diverse and faithful to the relevant agent harness contracts. paragraphs.en: The quantitative results in RQ1 reveal overall test insufficiency in agent codebase and LLM-dependent harness code. Meanwhile, aggregate metrics alone cannot reveal whether these testing gaps are uniformly distributed in particular types of LLM-dependent harness logic. This distinction is important, as LDH code can contain rich semantics to serve different responsibilities in agent workflows, which may present different testing challenges. In this RQ, we therefore characterize the semantics of LDH branch predicates and examine test coverage across different semantic categories to understand which types of LLM-dependent harness logic are adequately covered and where important testing gaps remain. We focus on branch predicates as they often represent critical decision points that govern agent behavior and encode rich semantics.

paragraphs.en: To this end, we first randomly sample 700 LLM-dependent harness branch predicates from all studied agents. Specifically, we analyze each predicate from three perspectives: (i) component intention , which refers to the responsibility that the predicate fulfills within the agent workflow; (ii) judgment pattern , which refers to the decision rule encoded by the predicate when evaluating LLM-derived values; and (iii) LLM value form , which refers to the runtime representation of LLM-derived values. As there is no existing taxonomy on semantics of LDH branch predicates, we develop our taxonomy through an open-coding process ( Strauss and Corbin, 1998 ; Seaman, 1999 ) . Two annotators, each with five years of software development experience and substantial experience with agents, first perform a pilot study on another small set of predicates and assign descriptive codes without relying on predefined categories. They then discuss and consolidate the resulting codes, iteratively refining the categories and their definitions until reaching a stable codebook. Using the finalized codebook, the two annotators independently label all the sampled predicates. Cohen’s κ \kappa on these independent annotations before resolving disagreements is 0.96, indicating high inter-annotator agreement ( Cohen, 1960 ) . Remaining disagreements are resolved through discussion with a third reviewer.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们首先从所有研究的智能体中随机抽取 700 个依赖 LLM 的 harness 分支谓词。 具体而言，我们从三个角度分析每个谓词：(i) 组件意图，指该谓词在智能体工作流程中承担的职责；(ii) 判断模式，指该谓词在评估 LLM 生成的值时所编码的决策规则；以及 (iii) LLM 值形式，指 LLM 生成的值在运行时的表现形式。 由于目前尚无关于 LDH 分支谓词语义的现有分类体系，我们通过开放式编码过程（Strauss and Corbin, 1998; Seaman, 1999）构建了自己的分类体系。 两位标注员各自拥有五年软件开发经验以及丰富的智能体使用经验，他们首先对另一组较小的谓词集合进行试点研究，并在不依赖预定义类别的情况下分配描述性编码。 随后，他们讨论并整合所得编码，迭代优化各类别及其定义，直至形成稳定的编码手册。 使用最终确定的编码手册，两位标注员独立为所有抽取的谓词添加标签。 在解决分歧之前，这些独立标注结果的 Cohen’s κ \kappa 值为 0.96，表明标注员之间的一致性很高（Cohen, 1960）。 其余分歧则通过与第三位评审员讨论解决。

paragraphs.en: Component Intention. We observe six main categories of component intention across the inspected LDH branch predicates. Among them, provider I/O normalization and tool action handling account for 29.14% and 23.57% of LDH branch predicates, respectively. Together, these two categories comprise more than half of the inspected predicates, showing that LDH branch predicates frequently govern the processing of provider responses and the selection, validation, and gating of model-proposed actions. This concentration highlights the important role of LDH branch predicates in mediating the transition from model-produced information to downstream agent execution.
paragraphs.zh: 组件意图。 我们在检查的 LDH 分支谓词中观察到六大类组件意图。 其中，提供者 I/O 标准化和工具动作处理分别占 LDH 分支谓词的 29.14% 和 23.57%。 这两类谓词合计占检查谓词的一半以上，表明 LDH 分支谓词经常控制对提供者响应的处理，以及对模型提议的动作的选择、验证和限制。 这种集中现象凸显了 LDH 分支谓词在协调模型生成信息向下游智能体执行过渡方面的重要作用。

paragraphs.en: Judgment Pattern. Almost half of LDH branch predicates perform presence or shape checks (e.g., 47.14%), which mainly check the structures of LLM-derived values (e.g., expected type, fields, schema, or container structure). Other recurring patterns enumerate the common properties, such as concrete values, sizes, content patterns, or policies. Overall, LLM-dependent harness branch predicates primarily determine (i) whether model-derived information is available in the expected structure, and (ii) which execution path to follow based on its value. Testing LDH therefore requires systematically varying both the structure and values of model-derived inputs to exercise distinct branch outcomes, rather than randomly constructing plausible model responses.
paragraphs.zh: 判断模式。 近一半的 LDH 分支谓词执行存在性或形状检查（例如，47.14%），这些检查主要验证由 LLM 生成的值的结构（例如，预期类型、字段、模式或容器结构）。 其他重复出现的模式会枚举常见属性，例如具体值、大小、内容模式或策略。 总体而言，依赖 LLM 的测试分支谓词主要决定：(i) 模型生成的信息是否以预期结构存在，以及 (ii) 根据该信息的值应选择哪条执行路径。 因此，测试 LDH 需要系统地改变模型生成输入的结构和值，以触发不同的分支结果，而不是随机构造看似合理的模型响应。

paragraphs.en: LLM Value Form. We observe five forms of LLM-derived values. In addition to immediate model outputs, such as generated content and provider response signals, accounting for 25.00% and 6.57% of LDH branch predicates, LDH branch predicates also process (i) indirect LLM-derived values accumulated throughout agent execution, such as agent context state (21.71%), and (ii) heterogeneous runtime values that depend on model outputs, such as tool action payloads (21.71%) and observation feedback signals (25.00%). paragraphs.en: Test Coverage Across Semantic Patterns. We further examine whether existing tests cover different semantic categories of LDH branch predicates equally well or leave gaps in particular categories. We classify each LDH branch predicate as fully covered , partially covered , or uncovered , depending on whether all, some but not all, or none of its decision outcomes are exercised. We report the coverage by category in Figure 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 跨语义模式的测试覆盖。 我们进一步检验现有测试是否对 LDH 分支谓词的不同语义类别实现了同等程度的覆盖，或者是否存在某些类别的覆盖空白。 根据每个 LDH 分支谓词的所有决策结果是否都被执行，我们将它们分为完全覆盖、部分覆盖或未覆盖。 我们在图 1 中报告了按类别划分的覆盖情况。

This pattern separates two forms of incompleteness: many LLM-dependent predicate decisions are never reached, while many others are reached without all outcomes of the encoded decision boundary being exercised.

paragraphs.en: Coverage Across Component Intention. A clear coverage contrast emerges across different component intentions. Tool action handling achieves the highest full-coverage rate at 38.18% (63/165), with 61.21% (101/165) of its branch predicates having at least one outcome exercised. In contrast, agent orchestration control predicates exhibit lowest coverage, only 14.29% (14/98) of predicates are fully covered, while 63.27% (62/98) remain uncovered. Observation feedback and error recovery handling show similarly low full-coverage rates of 18.39% (16/87) and 17.65% (9/51), respectively. One possible explanation is that tool actions typically follow explicit schemas, making it easier to construct valid payloads and systematically vary them. In contrast, orchestration, feedback, and error recovery often depend on dynamically evolving execution contexts, including prior interactions, accumulated agent states, and cross-component behavior. Reproducing and varying such contexts while satisfying the relevant agent-harness contracts can therefore be more challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 各组件意图的覆盖范围。 不同组件意图之间出现了明显的覆盖对比。 工具动作处理实现了最高的完全覆盖率，为 38.18%（63/165），其中 61.21%（101/165）的分支谓词至少有一个结果被触发。 相比之下，智能体编排控制谓词的覆盖率最低，仅有 14.29%（14/98）的谓词被完全覆盖，而 63.27%（62/98）仍未被覆盖。 观察反馈和错误恢复处理的完全覆盖率同样较低，分别为 18.39%（16/87）和 17.65%（9/51）。 一种可能的解释是，工具动作通常遵循明确的模式，因此更容易构建有效的负载并系统地对其进行变化。 相比之下，编排、反馈和错误恢复往往依赖于动态变化的执行上下文，包括先前的交互、累积的智能体状态以及跨组件的行为。 因此，在满足相关智能体框架契约的同时，重现并变化此类上下文可能更具挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Coverage Across Judgment Patterns. Coverage also varies substantially across judgment patterns. Policy guards achieve the highest full-coverage rate at 50.00% (15/30). This may be because policies are often implemented as functions or exposed through interfaces, thus providing a clear and controllable decision space: tests can directly mock the corresponding policy interfaces to return different decisions, making alternative branch outcomes relatively easy to exercise. In contrast, such direct guidance is not always available for other judgment patterns. Only 22.12% of presence or shape checks, 18.69% of size or threshold checks, and 30.47% of value or pattern matching predicates are fully covered, with more than 48% of each category remaining uncovered. For these patterns, the values inspected by a predicate may be produced through preceding parsing, or data transformations, making the required inputs less apparent. Constructing tests for different outcomes may therefore require reasoning backward from the target predicate to establish appropriate upstream inputs and states while satisfying the relevant agent-harness contracts.

paragraphs.en: Coverage Across Value Forms. Branch predicates over tool action payloads are the most thoroughly exercised: 43.42% are fully covered, and 63.82% have at least one exercised outcome. Full-coverage rates are substantially lower for generated content (17.71%), observation feedback signals (20.57%), and agent context state (21.71%). Moreover, 60.00% of generated-content predicates and 55.43% of observation-feedback predicates remain uncovered. One possible explanation is that tool action payloads typically have a relatively bounded and explicit value space: available actions and their argument schemas provide clear guidance for constructing valid inputs and systematically varying them. In contrast, generated content has a more open-ended value space, making it difficult to enumerate the content and structural variations needed to exercise downstream logic. Agent context and observation feedback can be even more challenging, as their values evolve throughout agent execution based on prior interactions, execution results, and runtime states. Their relevant value spaces are therefore difficult to enumerate in advance, requiring tests to reproduce and vary values along the execution flow while preserving the expected runtime context.

paragraphs.en: Our study above reveals prevalent test inadequacy in LLM-dependent harness across real-world agentic systems, motivating the need for effective harness-oriented test generation techniques. paragraphs.en: Figure 2 presents the overall workflow of HarnessTester . Following the coverage-driven test generation paradigm, given an agent codebase and its existing test suite, HarnessTester iteratively identifies LDH code that is uncovered by existing tests as targets and generates new tests to cover the target. Different from existing LLM-driven test generation techniques designed for general software, the key insight of HarnessTester is to make harness-oriented test generation explicitly aware of agent harness contracts . As discussed in Section 4 , agent harness contracts refer to the requirements that must hold across interactions among harness components for valid execution, such as expected data structures, execution preconditions, and interaction protocols. To this end, HarnessTester augments general LLM-based test generation with agent harness contract support , which helps LLM construct contract-faithful test contexts via prompt-level guidance (i.e., agent-harness contract guidance) and tool-level enhancement (i.e., agent-harness contract context retriever).

paragraphs.en: Agent-Harness Contract Guidance. The guidance consists of a set of high-level, contract-aware principles embedded in the prompts used for iterative test generation and refinement. Its main goal is to guide the model to preserve key agent-harness contracts when constructing tests, including maintaining the expected runtime representations of provider responses, tool actions, and observations; constructing the agent state or interaction history required to reach the target behavior; respecting cross-component invocation contracts, such as synchronous/asynchronous calling conventions and expected return shapes; and installing contract-faithful test doubles at the actual bindings or injection points used by the code under test. These principles are derived from testing challenges identified in our study above. Beyond contract fidelity, the guidance also promotes diversity by encouraging LLM to prioritize distinct behavioral partitions rather than generating additional variants of already exercised behavior. Detailed prompts are in our artifact ( HarnessTester, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Agent-Harness Contract Context Retriever. While the contract guidance above mainly provides prompt-level principles that direct LLM to important contract requirements, generating and refining a concrete harness-oriented test also requires relevant code context to show how these harness contracts are implemented in agent codebase. Therefore, to complement the prompt-level contract guidance, the harness contract context retriever further serves as a callable context collection tool, which retrieves contract-relevant code context on demand during test generation. Such context includes the code needed to construct or control the test setup, such as the definition of a constructor, fixture, collaborator, or mock target. Specifically, when invoking the retriever, the LLM requests a class, function, or method definition by providing its source file and exact symbol name, which can often be inferred from imports in the current file. For example, if the target logic requires an “Action” input defined elsewhere, an import such as “ from pkg.actions import Action ” identifies the module “pkg.actions”, corresponding to the source file “pkg/actions.py”. The LLM can therefore request the definition of “Action” from that file. The retrieved definition exposes the required fields and their types, helping the LLM construct a contract-faithful mock action that serves as a valid input for exercising the target logic. Upon receiving the request, the retriever deterministically resolves it using AST-based matching for symbol definitions and bounded extraction for surrounding module context. This demand-driven retrieval complements the high-level guidance with repository-specific context needed to construct contract-faithful test setups and make the target behavior reachable and controllable.

paragraphs.en: Baselines. As there are no existing test generation techniques designed for agent harness code, we compare HarnessTester with four state-of-the-art test generation techniques that are designed for general software systems. For the agents implemented in Python, we include CoverUp ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) and TestTailor ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) as baselines, two recent LLM-driven test generation approaches for general Python software; for the agents implemented in TypeScript, we include Qodo Cover ( Qodo AI, 2025 ) and TestPilot 2 ( Schäfer et al., 2024 ; neu-se, 2024 ) , two recent LLM-driven test generation techniques for general TypeScript software. To isolate the effect of contract-specific design in HarnessTester , we include a contract-agnostic variant of HarnessTester by removing the agent harness contract support.

sents.zh: 由于目前尚无专为智能体框架代码设计的测试生成技术，我们将 HarnessTester 与四种为通用软件系统设计的先进测试生成技术进行了比较。

sents.en: For the agents implemented in Python, we include CoverUp ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) and TestTailor ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) as baselines, two recent LLM-driven test generation approaches for general Python software; for the agents implemented in TypeScript, we include Qodo Cover ( Qodo AI, 2025 ) and TestPilot 2 ( Schäfer et al., 2024 ; neu-se, 2024 ) , two recent LLM-driven test generation techniques for general TypeScript software.
sents.zh: 对于用 Python 实现的智能体，我们纳入了 CoverUp（Altmayer Pizzorno 和 Berger，2025）和 TestTailor（Zhou 等人，2026）作为基线方法，这两种是近期用于通用 Python 软件的 LLM 驱动测试生成方法；对于用 TypeScript 实现的智能体，我们纳入了 Qodo Cover（Qodo AI，2025）和 TestPilot 2（Schäfer 等人，2024；neu-se，2024），这两种是近期用于通用 TypeScript 软件的 LLM 驱动测试生成技术。

sents.en: To isolate the effect of contract-specific design in HarnessTester , we include a contract-agnostic variant of HarnessTester by removing the agent harness contract support.
sents.zh: 为了孤立 HarnessTester 中合同特定设计的影响，我们通过移除智能体框架合同支持，纳入了一个不依赖合同的 HarnessTester 变体。

paragraphs.en: Experimental Process. We include two test generation settings, including (i) general project-wide generation , which does not specify any target but aims at the entire codebase of the studied agentic system; (ii) scoped LDH-wide generation , which provides the LDH-containing files as the targets. For all baselines, we directly use their released implementation, configuring their target scope for each setting while retaining their native generation workflows. In the scoped setting, the baselines receive the same LDH-containing file as HarnessTester for a fair comparison. We use GPT-5-mini ( OpenAI, 2025 ) as the backbone LLM for all studied techniques given its cost-effectiveness. Following previous work on application-level automated testing ( Yoon et al., 2024 ; Lan et al., 2024 ) , all techniques are executed with a 120-minute timed budget per project.

paragraphs.en: Consistent LDH Coverage Gains. HarnessTester consistently achieves the highest final LDH-wide line- and branch coverage gains among all studied baselines, indicating its effectiveness in improving test adequacy for LLM-dependent harness code. Moreover, this advantage emerges early in the test-generation process: e.g., LDH-wide branch coverage gains lead across all ten projects from the 30-minute checkpoint onward, and line coverage gains do so from 75 minutes onward.

paragraphs.en: Substantial Gains in Targeted Test Generation. Although restricting test generation to LDH-bearing files substantially benefits baselines (e.g., 25.09% and 23.15% higher gains compared with the general setting), HarnessTester still substantially outperforms all the baselines with the scoped setting. At 120 minutes, HarnessTester achieves macro-averaged LDH line- and branch-coverage gains of 25.84 and 25.41 percentage points, respectively, with the line-coverage gain reaching 68.77 points on GPT Researcher. Compared with the strongest scoped baseline selected separately for each agent and metric, these average gains are 82.27% and 94.36% larger, respectively. Against the strongest general external baselines, the corresponding improvements are 95.29% and 109.22%. These results confirm the advantage of HarnessTester over baselines in the targeted test generation scenario.

paragraphs.en: Contribution from Harness Contract Support. The pronounced performance drop from HarnessTester to its contract-agnostic variant (the “Agnostic” in Figure 3 ) confirms the effectiveness of our key design on harness contract support. In particular, HarnessTester produces 96.51% larger mean line-coverage gains and 96.24% larger branch-coverage gains, outperforming the contract-agnostic variant on both metrics in every project. We further run a fine-grained ablation analysis on OpenHands using variants without harness contract guidance and the harness contract context retriever, respectively. We observe consistent decreases in LDH line/branch coverage gains (43.26%/45.98% and 37.38%/41.00%, respectively) compared to HarnessTester , indicating the complementary contribution of each mechanism to harness contract support.

paragraphs.en: Prevalent Improvements Across Semantic Categories. To examine whether HarnessTester improves test adequacy across the diverse semantic categories identified in RQ2, we further report category-level coverage improvements in Figure 5 . Improvements are observed across all semantic categories: 12.12–25.49% of predicates in each category transition from uncovered to fully covered, while another 2.86–10.87% transition from partially to fully covered. Notably, for the challenging category of Agent Orchestration Control , where stateful and cross-component logic requires carefully coordinated test setups, 22.45% of branch predicates move from uncovered to fully covered and another 5.10% from partially to fully covered. These broad improvements suggest that HarnessTester can effectively exercise semantically diverse LDH behaviors, including those requiring complex test setups. The improvement aligns with the design intuition of using contract guidance and retrieved harness context to construct contract-faithful setups with diverse inputs.

paragraphs.en: Mutant Detection Effectiveness. Figure 6 presents the mutation score gains achieved by all studied techniques. Overall, HarnessTester achieves the highest mutation-score gain on every studied agent, outperforming all baselines and its contract-agnostic variant. Its largest percentage-point margin over the strongest baseline occurs on SWE-agent, where it gains 43.01 points compared with 22.15 for CoverUp (Scoped). Its advantage on OpenClaw appears smaller in percentage-point terms, partly resulting from the large measurement denominator: HarnessTester ’s 0.39-point gain corresponds to 185 additional kills over a pool of 46,967 mutants, compared with 147 for Qodo Cover (Scoped) and 141 for the contract-agnostic variant. Despite the small percentage-point differences, HarnessTester nevertheless kills 38 and 44 more mutants, respectively. Manual inspection of the generated tests and mutation results shows that they kill both mutants at previously uncovered locations and mutants that survived despite being exercised by the original suite. Overall, the improved capabilities of mutant detection further support HarnessTester ’s effectiveness in improving agent-harness test adequacy.

paragraphs.en: Benchmark and Process. To systematically evaluate the precision and recall of bug detection, we first build H-Bench , a benchmark of 250 real-world harness bugs historically reported and fixed across 10 studied agentic systems, including 140 bugs from seven Python agents and 110 from three TypeScript agents. We construct the benchmark by mining historical bug-fixing commits and retaining bugs whose patches involve LDH code, thereby focusing on bugs in LLM-dependent harness logic, given its importance ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . To reduce leakage from existing regression tests, we retain only bugs that cannot be exposed by any test in the buggy revision, preventing the LLMs from simply reusing existing bug-revealing tests for test generation. To the best of our knowledge, H-Bench is the first benchmark dedicated to real-world LLM-dependent harness bugs, and we release it in our artifact ( HarnessTester, 2026 ) for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 基准与流程。 为了系统性地评估缺陷检测的精确率和召回率，我们首先构建了 H-Bench——一个包含 250 个真实世界 harness 缺陷的基准数据集。这些缺陷均已在 10 个受研究的智能体系统中历史报告并修复，其中包括来自 7 个 Python 智能体的 140 个缺陷和来自 3 个 TypeScript 智能体的 110 个缺陷。 我们通过挖掘历史上的缺陷修复提交记录来构建该基准数据集，并保留其补丁涉及 LDH 代码的缺陷，从而专注于 LLM 依赖的 harness 逻辑中的缺陷，鉴于此类缺陷的重要性（Chen et al., 2026）。 为了减少现有回归测试带来的信息泄露，我们仅保留那些在存在缺陷的版本中无法被任何测试暴露的缺陷，以防止 LLM 简单地重复利用现有的缺陷揭示测试来生成测试。 据我们所知，H-Bench 是首个专门针对真实世界中 LLM 依赖的 harness 缺陷的基准数据集，我们已在研究产物（HarnessTester, 2026）中将其发布，以供未来研究使用。

paragraphs.en: Given the large manual effort involved in inspecting test failures, in this RQ, we compare HarnessTester with the two best-performing baselines in RQ3 (i.e., CoverUp for Python and Qodo Cover for TypeScript). In particular, for each case, we provide each technique with the buggy location (e.g., the functions or classes where the developer-submitted patch occurs) as the target code for test generation, but without exposing the patch, bug description, or fixed-side implementation. A bug is considered plausibly detected only if the generated test fails on the buggy version but passes on the fixed version. We then manually review all plausible detections to verify whether the test exposes the same bug fixed by developers or instead constitutes a false positive.

paragraphs.en: Results. Table 4 presents the number of detected true bugs (TP) and false positives (FP) of all studied techniques on H-Bench with the total generation costs per project. Overall, HarnessTester achieves the highest bug detection rate (17.20%) by detecting 43 historical bugs, while the best baseline can only detect 2 historical bugs (0.80%). In addition, removing harness-contract support reduces the number of revealed bugs from 43 (17.20%) to 15 (6.00%), while the proportion of false positives among retained differential outcomes increases from 14.00% to 25.00%. Manual review identified typical false positives arising from fixtures that violated production-side agent-harness contracts or assertions that assumed unsupported behavior. For example, one test omitted a required command field from a tool-call payload but expected an undocumented fallback; another passed a bracketed IP literal to a helper whose caller supplies normalized hostnames. These cases reinforce the need for agent-harness contract fidelity: fixtures and mocks must preserve production-established contracts to help the test reach the target in a valid way, and must not demand behavior beyond existing contracts. In terms of cost, HarnessTester is more expensive overall but substantially more cost-effective for bug revealing. Across 250 cases, HarnessTester reveals 43 bugs at a total cost of $77.58, or $1.80 per revealed bug, compared with $10.84 per bug for the baseline.

paragraphs.en: Results. Table 5 summarizes our detected bugs and their upstream outcomes. paragraphs.en: Real-World Example. Listing 8.2 shows a previously-unknown sensitive-data leakage bug in Browser Use detected by HarnessTester and confirmed by developers. The system records model-selected tool calls as typed actions in the agent execution history. Our generated test reveals that a sensitive value nested within a typed action parameter can bypass redaction and remain in the saved history. In the persistence path, dump_actions serializes the actions, while redact_dict delegates list-valued fields to redact_list , which handles strings and dictionaries but leaves nested lists unchanged. Consequently, the synthetic credential nested in rows remains unredacted in the saved history. Revealing this bug requires more than placing a secret in an arbitrary payload. The test must embed a schema-valid input in a valid chain of action, model-output, and history objects, provide the expected sensitive-data mapping, and inspect the resulting file. This illustrates the role of agent-harness contracts: the test setup must preserve the runtime representations, object relationships, and interactions expected by the target logic. The test must further vary this valid setup with a nested-list input containing the sensitive value. Neither the best-performing Python baseline (CoverUp) nor our contract-agnostic variant revealed this bug. After confirmation, the bug was fixed upstream through recursive redaction.
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界中的示例。 列表 8.2 展示了 HarnessTester 检测到并由开发人员确认的、此前未知的一种浏览器使用场景中的敏感数据泄露漏洞。 系统会将模型选择的工具调用以“已输入动作”的形式记录在智能体执行历史中。 我们生成的测试表明，嵌套在已输入动作参数中的敏感值可能绕过脱敏处理，并保留在保存的历史记录中。 在持久化路径中，dump_actions 会将动作序列化，而 redact_dict 则会将列表类型的字段委托给 redact_list；redact_list 会处理字符串和字典，但不会修改嵌套的列表。 因此，嵌套在行中的合成凭证在保存的历史记录中仍然未被脱敏。 要揭示这一漏洞，仅将秘密信息置于任意负载中是远远不够的。 该测试必须将符合模式规范的输入嵌入到由动作、模型输出和历史对象构成的有效链中，提供预期的敏感数据映射，并检查最终生成的文件。 这说明了智能体测试框架契约的作用：测试设置必须保留目标逻辑所依赖的运行时表现形式、对象关系和交互方式。 此外，该测试还必须通过一个包含敏感值的嵌套列表输入，对这一有效设置进行变化。 无论是表现最佳的 Python 基线方法（CoverUp），还是我们脱离契约的变体，均未揭示出这一漏洞。 经确认后，该漏洞通过递归脱敏在上游得到了修复。

paragraphs.en: External Validity. The generality of our findings can be scoped to our studied agents. To mitigate this threat, we select diverse and actively developed systems (e.g., OpenClaw) spanning different application domains, implementation languages, and agent architectures. Similarly, our evaluation considers a representative set of existing test generation techniques and configurations, while other techniques or models may yield different results. We therefore release our benchmark and implementation to facilitate replication and evaluation on additional systems and techniques ( HarnessTester, 2026 ) . Internal Validity. The semantic pattern analysis in RQ2 relies on manual labeling and may be subject to human judgment. To reduce this threat, two experienced annotators independently label the sampled branches using an explicitly defined codebook, achieving high inter-annotator agreement ( κ = 0.96 \kappa=0.96 ), with remaining disagreements resolved through discussion with a third reviewer. Our metric calculation and implementation may be subject to implementation errors. To mitigate this threat, we validate intermediate results, manually inspect representative cases, and use established coverage and mutation-testing tools whenever applicable to reduce potential measurement errors.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 我们研究结果的普遍性可限定于我们所研究的智能体。 为缓解这一威胁，我们选择了多样化且处于活跃开发中的系统（例如 OpenClaw），这些系统覆盖了不同的应用领域、实现语言和智能体架构。 同样，我们的评估考虑了现有测试生成技术和配置的代表性集合，而其他技术或模型可能会产生不同的结果。 因此，我们公开了基准和实现代码，以便在更多系统和技术上进行复现与评估（HarnessTester, 2026）。内部效度。 RQ2 中的语义模式分析依赖于人工标注，可能受到人类判断的影响。 为减少这一威胁，两名经验丰富的标注员使用明确定义的编码手册独立对采样分支进行标注，实现了高度一致的标注者间一致性（κ = 0.96 \kappa=0.96），其余分歧则通过与第三位评审员讨论解决。 我们的指标计算和实现可能存在实施错误。 为缓解这一威胁，我们验证了中间结果，手动检查了代表性案例，并在适用时使用了成熟的覆盖率和变异测试工具，以减少潜在的测量误差。

paragraphs.en: This work presents the first study of test adequacy in real-world agent harness and reveals substantial test-adequacy gaps in exercising the critical LLM-dependent harness code. We find that these gaps are particularly pronounced when testing requires dynamic execution contexts, implicit input spaces, and cross-component interactions. Motivated by these findings, we propose HarnessTester , the first harness-oriented test generation technique that incorporates agent-harness contract support to construct contract-faithful tests for LLM-dependent harness code. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that HarnessTester substantially outperforms general-purpose test generation in coverage and mutation-score gains, while its contract support contributes significantly to these improvements. Furthermore, HarnessTester detects 122 real-world harness bugs in widely-used agentic systems (e.g., OpenClaw). 88 of them are previously-unknown bugs and 69 of them have been confirmed by developers. Overall, our findings highlight the practical value of building harness-oriented test generation in improving the reliability of real-world agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究首次探讨了真实世界中智能体运行环境中的测试充分性，并揭示了在执行关键依赖大型语言模型（LLM）的运行环境代码时存在的显著测试充分性差距。 我们发现，当测试需要动态执行上下文、隐式输入空间以及跨组件交互时，这些差距尤为明显。 基于这些发现，我们提出了 HarnessTester——首个面向运行环境的测试生成技术，它整合了对智能体运行环境契约的支持，从而为依赖大型语言模型（LLM）的运行环境代码构建符合契约的测试。 广泛的评估表明，HarnessTester 在覆盖率和变异得分提升方面显著优于通用测试生成方法，而其对契约的支持对这些改进起到了关键作用。 此外，HarnessTester 在广泛使用的智能体系统（如 OpenClaw）中检测到了 122 个真实运行环境中的缺陷，其中 88 个是此前未知的缺陷，69 个已得到开发人员的确认。 总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了构建面向运行环境的测试生成技术对于提升真实世界智能体系统可靠性的实际价值。
